limitations.note: The patch renamed the existing `slave_mod` ports `a` and `b`, so external named-port instantiations using the original interface would no longer compile.
The patch correctly aligned the pipeline, but replacing the comparator's `if/else` with a ternary also changed simulation behavior when the comparison evaluates to unknown.
The test verified pipeline timing and reset through `TopModule`, but never instantiated `slave_mod` with its original named ports, so it could not catch the interface regression.
